description_en: Queries information about Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connections under an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the status, billing type, zone information, and associated vSwitch and network interface controller (NIC) details of VPC connections that are active for forwarding and routing traffic
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）VPC连接的状态、VPC连接的付费类型、VPC连接的可用区信息及其关联的VPC实例的交换机和弹性网卡信息等

name: ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

Once specified, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be empty or a string of up to 128 characters. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The payer of the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The fees generated by the network instance are paid by the account that owns the CEN instance.
PayByResourceOwner: The fees generated by the network instance are paid by the account that owns the network instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由云企业网实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由网络实例所属的账号承担
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The attachment status of the network instance.

Attaching: being attached.
Attached: attached.
Detaching: being detached
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的加载状态。

Attaching：加载中。
Attached：已加载。
Detaching：卸载中
parameters.name: status

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically publishes route entries to the VPC instance.

false: The forward router does not automatically publish route entries.
true: The forward router automatically publishes route entries
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_zh:
企业版转发路由器是否自动发布路由到VPC实例。

false：否。
true：是

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing type of the VPC connection.

The value is POSTPAY, which indicates pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
VPC连接的付费类型。

仅取值：POSTPAY，表示按使用量后付费

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the VPC connection was created.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
CreationTime.description_zh:
VPC连接的创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ

ManagedService.description_en: The cloud service to which the connection belongs

ApplianceModeSupport.description_en:
Indicates whether the appliance mode is enabled.

disable (default): No.
enable: Yes
ApplianceModeSupport.description_zh:
是否开启网元导流模式。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是

Ipv6Support.description_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 is supported.

disable (default): No.
enable: Yes
Ipv6Support.description_zh:
是否支持IPv6。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是

OrderType.description_en:
The payer of the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The fees generated by the network instance are paid by the account that owns the CEN instance.
PayByResourceOwner: The fees generated by the network instance are paid by the account that owns the network instance
OrderType.description_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由云企业网实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由网络实例所属的账号承担

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource type of the connection.

The value is VPC, which indicates a VPC instance
ResourceType.description_zh:
连接所属的资源类型。

仅取值：VPC，表示专有网络实例

Status.description_en:
The status of the VPC connection.

Attached: attached.
Attaching: being attached.
Detaching: being detached
Status.description_zh:
VPC连接的状态。

Attached：已加载。
Attaching：加载中。
Detaching：卸载中

TransitRouterAttachmentDescription.description_en: The description of the VPC connection

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_en: The name of the VPC connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID
TransitRouterId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID

additionalProperties.description_en:
The feature attribute of the VPC connection (to be deprecated. Use the new parameter Options instead).

ipv6Support: indicates whether IPv6 is enabled. The default value is the current IPv6 status of the VPC connection.
   
enable: IPv6 is enabled.
disable: IPv6 is disabled
additionalProperties.description_zh:
VPC连接的功能属性（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）。

ipv6Support：是否已开启IPv6功能。默认值为当前VPC连接IPv6功能开启的状态。
   
enable：已开启IPv6功能。
disable：未开启IPv6功能

TransitRouterVPCAttachmentOptions.description_en: The list of feature attributes of the VPC connection (to be deprecated. Use the new parameter Options instead)
TransitRouterVPCAttachmentOptions.description_zh: VPC连接的功能属性列表（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）

VpcOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the account that owns the VPC instance

VpcRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the VPC instance

ZoneMappings.description_en: The zone information of the VPC connection and the vSwitch and network interface controller (NIC) information of the associated VPC instance that are active for forwarding and routing traffic
ZoneMappings.description_zh: VPC连接的可用区信息及其关联的VPC实例的交换机和弹性网卡的信息

NetworkInterfaceId.description_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC) that the Enterprise Edition transit router created in the vSwitch for forwarding and routing traffic
NetworkInterfaceId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器在交换机中创建的弹性网卡的ID
